_comment: Merge the `hooks` block into your .claude/settings.local.json (or settings.json, in one reviewed commit: H6). INTERACTIVE sessions only: do not add it to a driver child's
profile (a child is told about its own stops by the driver). Every hook runs the human's `notify_command` through the kit's scripts/notify.py and sends nothing itself.
Replace /ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/KIT (twice in each command) with the folder /chain-of-custody:init and the doctor print as `kit:`. A project settings file cannot use
${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, and the installed plugin's folder names its version, so paste the path again after a plugin update. Every command ends in `exit 0`: with a
stale path or no python3 the hook does nothing, because a hook that exits 2 on PermissionRequest denies the permission prompt.
The hook event names Notification, StopFailure and PermissionRequest and the fields of their input are unverified on the pinned CLI (probe); notify.py reads only
hook_event_name, notification_type and tool_name from the input, never its free text, and does nothing when no notify_command is configured.
